title: Explainer: How China is managing the rising energy demand from data centres
notes: Carbon Brief (recognized climate outlet). China 25% of global DC electricity 2024 (2nd after US); 449 DCs end-2023; demand 100-200TWh 2025 -> 400-600TWh by 2030; ~200MtCO2e; PUE 1.48 (2023) target 1.25 by 2025; east-data-west-computing; renewables+nuclear 60% of DC supply by 2035; coal 60.5% of power mix.
